after.text:
Build on the story branch (T1 1a150bd + T2 39131c7). kvctl does not exist yet as code (bsim EPIC-260915-3slg4l is planned; its Signer interface will have backends file / macos-keychain / pkcs11), so mac-keyvault DEFINES the contract and kvctl will consume it: no live interop with kvctl is possible, state this bound. Deliver: (1) `mac-keyvault signer serve --address /

[--kind key] [--version N]` — JSON-lines over stdin/stdout, `contract: 1` announced in a hello line; ops: describe (record + operations), pub (spki-der base64 | pem), sign (sha256 digest hex, format ecdsa-der-low-s|ecdsa-raw), verify; every response carries {id, ok, result|error{code,message,hint}}; policy gates and the error contract from the STORY resource key-record-model-v2.md apply unchanged; unknown op / bad JSON / missing id -> error response, never exit; EOF -> clean exit 0. (2) Golden tests for the wire: request/response fixtures under internal/keyvault/testdata/signer-v1/*.json compared byte-exact, one negative per error code. (3) A Go client package internal/keyvault/signerclient (Serve-spawn + typed calls) so kvctl can vendor the exact contract, with a test that drives the real binary through the client against a test-label key. (4) Docs: README Tools row and Key Vault section update, SKILL.md section (when to use, ACL prompts the user will see incl. the one-time keychain prompt when the binary changes, keychain vs enclave, extraction policy and that agents never pass --human-authorized, how kvctl selects the macos-keychain backend and the contract version), LOGBOOK entry; setup.sh already builds mac-keyvault (verify).
